title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This report details the national coaching camp for India's promising junior players ahead of a major continental championship.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is currently hosting the Indian team's coaching camp in preparation for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: Final Selection Trials List Released for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This news provides crucial information for Indian junior players aspiring to represent the nation at the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: BAI has announced the list of eligible players who have qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, set to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Who Will Follow Satwik-Chirag in India's Doubles Pipeline?
indian_angle: This article explores the critical question of developing the next generation of Indian doubles talent, following the success of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.
summary: Chief national coach Pullela Gopichand emphasizes the need for a structured system to nurture grassroots talent and bridge the gap to the world elite in Indian badminton doubles, looking beyond the current success of Satwik-Chirag.

title: India's Medal Prospects at Home World Championships Decoded
indian_angle: With India hosting the World Championships, this preview analyzes the chances of top Indian stars like PV Sindhu, Lakshya Sen, and Satwik-Chirag.
summary: As India prepares to host the BWF World Championships for the first time in 17 years, an analysis breaks down the medal prospects for key Indian players including PV Sindhu, Lakshya Sen, and the men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.
